summary: Decision is ERROR and cannot be approved: the required AI review result is missing (AI_REQUIRED_UNAVAILABLE), so the hard guard rule blocks release. Beyond that blocker, the report itself flags review-level concerns: 35 scheduled Pods lack CPU/memory requests and are counted as zero, so free capacity may be overstated; a KubeCPUOvercommit warning alert is firing; and request rate (~0.0035 rps) is far below the 0.1 rps threshold, so zero errors and low p95 are not evidence of health. Capacity math (50m CPU / 64Mi per replica, 1 surge Pod, 2190m available) looks nominally sufficient but rests on the unreserved-request assumption. The change adds a new Deployment, Service, and ServiceMonitor with a changed pod template, so rollout behavior is unverified. Recommend resolving the missing AI review, confirming real requests on all scheduled Pods, and re-evaluating under meaningful traffic before any approval.
